author: Nathanmg
what_it_is: All complete except time trials - PAL
format: MaxDrive .sav: a 0x80-byte header ('DATELGC_SAVE', title 'Mario Kart: Double Dash!!', description 'Mario Kart: Double Dash!! - complete'), the card directory entry with bytes 0x06/0x07 and the pairs 0x2C-0x3F byte-swapped (GM4P01, file 'MarioKart Double Dash!!', 3 blocks, comment 'Mario Kart: Double Dash!! / Game Data 02/09/04'), then 3 x 8 KiB blocks = 24768 bytes

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/gc-gci.py place <file> <GC/USA/Card A>: drops the 0x80-byte MaxDrive header, swaps the directory entry's bytes back (as Dolphin's GCMemcardUtils reads .sav) and writes the plain GCI under Dolphin's own name for it

dolphin-emu.detail: no Mario Kart - Double Dash!! (Europe, Australia) (En,Fr,De,Es,It) disc image in the library (only the USA release)

dolphin-emu@dolphin.detail: no Mario Kart - Double Dash!! (Europe, Australia) (En,Fr,De,Es,It) disc image in the library (only the USA release)

note: The directory entry's modified time reads 2039-09-21 10:48:41, which matches nothing (the comment says Game Data 02/09/04); Dolphin does not swap that field in a .sav and neither does the converter. 1saves (0.4.0 and 0.7.0) takes this file for an unidentified flat cartridge save.
